notes.title: New Changelog
notes.content:
Thought I'd make a proper changelog for whenever we make small edits like this. If the game ever updates and you're wondering why, you can check here!

Version 4.03
[list]
[*]Updated credit for Polish translator.
[/list]

Version 4.05
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where, after an update, the game would start in Japanese and muted. The game now launches in English at 50% volume if it's been updated/reinstalled.
[/list]

Version 4.07
[list]
[*]Added version number to options screen.
[*]Added text animations (only affects English language).
[*]Added custom cursor.
[*]Added voice bites for every character.
[*]Fixed a few spelling/grammar/punctuation errors.
[*]For those who go through code, updated the im.MatrixColor properties to work with the newest version of Renpy. Shouldn’t affect gameplay, just code!
[*]On start up the character voice volume is 50% instead of 100% to match default SFX and music volumes.
[/list]

notes.title: Purrfect Apawcalypse 1: Now in Spanish!
notes.content:
hiya everyone! just wanted to let y'all know that pa1 is now available in european spanish thanks to [url=https://twitter.com/jesteragr]JesterAGR[/url]! big thanks to him for translating the game, i hope spanish speakers out there enjoy it! as always you can find the language option by the volume settings. that's it for now, have an awesome day! :D

notes.title: Small Update for Mobile Translations!
notes.content:
hello hello! i'm just updating the pa series on steam so the code is consistent between the games and their mobile versions, which will now be supporting all the translations the series has accumulated to date! included in this update are:
* small tweaks to button text sizes/positioning
* added translated main menu image for brazilian portuguese
* expanded the bani-regular font to include cyrillic characters
* changed button names for consistency between russian translations
* minor typo fixes

in other words, most things won't affect you if you're just playing the english version on pc. that's all for this minor update, hope yall have an amazing day and thank you as always for enjoying our games!!

notes.title: Purrfect Apawcalypse 1: Polish Update!
notes.content: got some helpful feedback from a polish-speaking fan and made some fixes to various typos, grammatical errors, certain sentence wordings, etc. i hope the translation's more enjoyable with these fixes and thanks for your patience as we get around to them! :)

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
just updated the trilogy with changes that don't really affect the player. this update just makes the code consistent with the mobile and itch versions of the game. this helps us fix bugs across the board if one crops up. thanks for playing and enjoy the steam summer sale! :>

edit: the update archived the images in the game folder by accident, they've now been unarchived for your memery! same goes for scripts now!

notes.title: Small Update! Version 2.3
notes.content: Fixed a bug where you eavesdrop on the cats in the basement with Sparky, and are able to do so again after getting Brownie to join you two!

notes.title: Release Date Change!
notes.content:
[b]The release date has been changed from the 15th to February 16th 2021 12:00 pm PST![/b] Sorry for the slight change, I just realized I wouldn't be able to publish the game within 14 days of the page going live as per Steam's requirements! 

By the way, thank you guys who've already had an interest in the Purrfect Apawcalypse series for a while. Putting a game on Steam is seriously a dream come true. I really hope you all enjoy this remake once it comes out! <3

- Denny
